definitions.explanation: The daughter of one's brother or sister. The 〜っ{子|こ} ending makes it warmer than plain {姪|めい}, and it is the everyday spoken form.

examples.japanese: {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三歳|さんさい}だ。
examples.english: My niece is three years old.

examples.japanese: {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Photos from my niece's school entrance ceremony arrived.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧{姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My niece, whom I hadn't seen in a long time, had grown up completely.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: to have a niece born
- {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かわい⟦がる→〜がる：03089_garu⟧: to dote on one's niece
- {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{甥|おい}っ{子|こ}→甥っ子：30760_oikko⟧: one's nieces and nephews

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姪|めい}→姪：03899_mei⟧: niece — the plain, neutral term used in writing and formal contexts
- ⟦{甥|おい}っ{子|こ}→甥っ子：30760_oikko⟧: nephew — the matching form
- ⟦いとこ→いとこ：01816_itoko⟧: cousin — a different relation that learners often mix up with ⟦{姪|めい}→姪：03899_mei⟧

Japanese has no single word covering both nieces and nephews, so speakers say ⟦{甥|おい}っ{子|こ}→甥っ子：30760_oikko⟧{姪|めい}っ{子|こ} when they mean the pair together.
